_note: Defaults. Trip and tech costs are also player options (Options > Mods); build.py writes them into modinfo.json configSchema. Trip cost is a multiple of vanilla (16 Voidbloom cells per trip, the 4x4 tile above the portal); 0 makes trips free. Tech costs use the vanilla research currency (vanilla Recall: 4,000; the dearest vanilla tech: 10,000). Distances are in cells, ring sizes in screen px.
